payload.body: issue-0037 head 3c6adff (on 1bf2a10), worktree ~/Devel/prj/Molt-wt/issue-0037, kept until you confirm the merge. web_upgrade, utilz_upgrade (checkout) and pplr_upgrade: molt_git_pull "$repo" "<Label>" || pulled=$?, "<Label> repo updated." on 0, hook returns [[ pulled is 0 or 2 ]] as editors_upgrade does. bin/bootstrap.sh clone_or_pull: no upstream (or detached) -> info "pull skipped: <dest> has no upstream branch"; else plain git pull --ff-only (stderr through), and on failure error "pull failed in <dest>: git's reason is above" + exit 1. No bootstrap bats (test/ has no clone_or_pull coverage); I ran clone_or_pull by hand in scratch: up to date passes, no upstream skips and continues, origin gone shows git's fatal lines and exits 1. Checked: mutation (the three hooks reverted) fails all three new tests; full suite all passing under /bin/bash 3.2; under bash 5.3 one failure, test/molt.bats 'molt_font_available resolves a family fontconfig actually lists', untouched by this, passing 3/3 on rerun, so flaky under load. shellcheck clean on the four sites; bootstrap.sh's two SC2088 warnings (lines 157/159, ~/bin/molt in quotes) are on main already, left.
